independence: Each model receives the same prompt and no other model's response.
selection_rule: Retain current production output unless a suggestion is strictly fact-preserving, mechanically invertible, generalizable across tool outputs, and testable without model judgment. Recurring suggestions may generate candidates but are not evidence of superiority.
reporting: Preserve raw model events and publish a labeled exploratory synthesis including disagreements and recommendations to make no change. Any selected candidate requires a newly frozen manifest before outcome collection.
